reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes purchasing OneCoin packages and joining a recruitment-based compensation structure while promising rapid capital growth and substantial income. The presentation explicitly describes binary teams, multiple generations of sponsor commissions, paid packages, and returns from selling or mining tokens, while assuring viewers that the scheme is not a pyramid. These claims and instructions encourage participation in a deceptive investment and recruitment solicitation rather than neutrally explaining cryptocurrency.

From first generation you'll get 10%

Thus you'll be able to return your investments within 5 months or even 5.5 months

opening.argument: The presentation uses qualified, forward-looking language rather than presenting guaranteed results as established facts. It calls the proposed program, in the speaker's view, an "anti-crisis program," describes the company's future position through its "ambitions" and "plans," and acknowledges that skepticism is legitimate. The speaker also expressly says that believing cryptocurrency is a "soap bubble" is a matter of individual judgment. Those qualifications support treating the material as promotional investment commentary and an optimistic forecast, not as a categorical assurance that every viewer will profit.

citations.quote: what I will tell you today is, in my opinion, a universal anti-crisis program for 2015
in 2-5 years, according to the ambitions, plans of the company
someone still believes that cryptocurrency is a soap bubble, it is the right of everyone to believe so

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's selected phrases describe proposed mechanisms and optimistic projections, but they do not establish that the speaker concealed uncertainty. "Build a two-legged left or right" explains a compensation structure; it does not prove that participation guarantees income. Likewise, a stated target of returning an investment within several months is a forecast, not proof that the forecast was represented as certain or fulfilled. The presentation's own language places the claims in the context of opinions, ambitions, and a still-developing project.

citations.quote: according to the ambitions according to the plans of the companies
I'm sure that they simply don't see the power of the recommendations

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Qualifications such as "in my opinion" do not neutralize the concrete profit claims. The presentation gives a specific recovery period and then describes multiplying capital several times, while the package-based structure and binary legs make the material actionable. Calling the claims forecasts does not change that viewers are encouraged to buy into the opportunity on the basis of those forecasts.

opening.argument: The material is structured as a recorded webinar that explains cryptocurrency concepts and the proposed system step by step. The speaker says the recording will be available to people who missed the webinar, then explains what mining means by comparing physical gold extraction with computer-based coin creation. The visual material likewise presents mining as an explanatory comparison between earlier gold extraction and contemporary computing infrastructure. That educational format supports classifying the video as a technology and business-process presentation, even if it also discusses an associated opportunity.

citations.quote: the topic of today's webinar is Business OneCoin, the webinar is being recorded
those who didn't get to our webinar today will be able to listen to the recording later
What is this mining? For those who are not familiar with it

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution characterizes the presentation by its commercial portions while overlooking its explanatory organization. The speaker introduces the webinar, explains cryptocurrency and mining, describes planned stages, and compares the proposal with Bitcoin. Discussing packages and compensation does not eliminate the instructional content or prove that the primary purpose was deception rather than presenting how the proposed business model operates.

citations.quote: The first stage that we are in is soft launch
what Bitcoin studied for a month what bitcoin is at all, what is it crypto currency

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the event a webinar and explaining mining does not make it a neutral lesson. The instructional material is used to support a purchase and recruitment pitch: the speaker says entry requires buying a package, explains token sales, and presents the partnership program as an additional way to earn. The educational framing therefore serves the solicitation rather than replacing it.

citations.quote: you still need to get into the join a business by buying a package
if you want to earn additionally, if you want to earn at the coming days and weeks
The token is financially available for sale at the OneExchange exchange

opening.argument: The concrete transactions described are ordinary commercial activities: purchasing a package that provides access to educational material and tokens, selling tokens on an internal exchange, and receiving commissions through a proposed payment card. The supplied material does not establish that a viewer was asked for credentials, that money was secretly deposited with the speaker, or that any particular return was guaranteed. It describes a product-and-payment ecosystem, and the mere presence of referral compensation does not by itself prove that the underlying service is fraudulent.

citations.quote: The price of the package gives you access to one level of academia
The token is financially available for sale at the OneExchange exchange
Soon the company will send such a payment card

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution infers a scam from the existence of referral and binary terminology, but those excerpts do not show credential theft, concealed deposits, or a fabricated transaction. A package, token exchange, and payment card are identifiable commercial components. The claim that commissions are linked to partners may warrant scrutiny, yet it does not alone establish that the product or service is nonexistent or that the presentation's claims were knowingly deceptive.

citations.quote: The second way of earning from you is binaries
The tokens enter the money-bans

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing mechanisms identified by the defense are not required to show this category. The presentation itself ties entry to buying packages, describes binary legs and sponsor generations, and promises recovery through token sales. Those are not merely ordinary retail features: the commercial opportunity is expressly built around recruitment-linked compensation and claimed returns from purchased tokens.
